localfile.command: /bin/bash -c 'ss -Hnt4 state syn-recv | awk '\''{split($4,l,":"); split($5,p,":"); print p[1],l[1],l[2]}'\'' | sort | uniq -c | awk '\''{print "ORANGEBOX_SYNRECV count="$1" srcip="$2" dstip="$3" dstport="$4}'\''; printf "ORANGEBOX_SYNRECV_TOTAL count="; ss -Hnt4 state syn-recv | wc -l'
/bin/bash -c 'cpu=$(ps -eo comm=,pcpu= | awk '\''$1 ~ /^ksoftirqd\// {sum += $2} END {printf "%.2f", sum+0}'\''); awk -v c="$cpu" '\''BEGIN {if (c >= 20) printf "ORANGEBOX_KSOFTIRQ cpu=%s\n", c}'\'''

/bin/bash -c 'read l1 l5 l15 rest < /proc/loadavg; c=$(nproc); awk -v c="$c" -v l1="$l1" -v l5="$l5" -v l15="$l15" '\''BEGIN {if (l1 > c) printf "ORANGEBOX_LOAD cpus=%d load1=%s load5=%s load15=%s\n", c,l1,l5,l15}'\'''
/bin/bash -c 'ps -eo pcpu=,args= --sort=-pcpu | awk '\''$2 ~ /php-fpm:/ && $3 == "pool" && $1+0 >= 25 {printf "ORANGEBOX_PHPFPM user=%s cpu=%s command=php-fpm pool %s\n", $4,$1,$4}'\'''
